purpose: Diagnostic correctness smoke; no matched performance/policy claim

observations.scope: Only original Scene.OnLoad Gen2 forced blocking compacting collection and RenderWindow.EndScene default collection; no added GC.
observations.limits: Collection wall excludes memory probes/callback; stage wall includes observer overhead and GL/audio/driver work. Stage scopes cover Scene.OnLoad and EndScene, not scene construction/AddRoom. GCMemoryInfo describes the indexed latest collection, which may predate skipped calls. Managed live bytes are an estimate; RSS includes native/runtime/driver memory. Readback/resource-stress frames are lifecycle evidence, never FPS. Frame tails require separate ordinary completed-frame runs on the same binary/fixture. Observation retains bounded value-only records identically across arms.

nextForegroundCleanup.scope: GC diagnostic cleanup: only weak scene reference and numeric handles cross EndScene; no extra GC or finalizer drain. Ordinary ownership-field inspection is a separate check.
